summary.name: Video (Wikipedia article)
summary.one_liner: A Wikipedia encyclopedia article explaining video as an electronic medium for recording, transmitting and displaying moving images, covering its history, formats, and technical characteristics.
use_cases: learning the basics of video technology
comparing analog and digital video formats
history of videotape and VCR formats
summary.what_it_does: The article describes video as a medium for recording, copying, playing back, transmitting and displaying moving images, and traces its development from mechanical scanners and CRT television to videotape, VCRs, optical discs and digital video. It explains technical characteristics such as frame rate, interlaced versus progressive scanning, aspect ratios, color models and chroma subsampling, and video quality measurement. It also covers compression (intraframe and interframe, MPEG-2 and MPEG-4), stereoscopic 3D methods, and lists analog and digital broadcast standards, connectors, recording formats and codecs.
notable: Covers history from Nipkow disk and 1951 Ampex videotape recorder to digital video
Detailed explanation of interlacing, deinterlacing and chroma subsampling
Extensive lists of analog and digital video formats and standards
caveats: Encyclopedia article, not a software tool; it does not offer streaming or video software itself
